Doubled the annual cash bonus for all junior analysts
Offered company shares at a fifty percent discount
Eliminated the mandatory retirement age limit

Disqualification from receiving year-end financial bonuses

financial analysts have witnessed
are financial analysts witnessing
witnessing financial analysts

questions.content: It is imperative that the lead regulatory compliance auditor ------- all clinical trial anomalies to the ethics board without delay.
options: report
reports
reported
reporting
questions.explanation: Thức giả định (Subjunctive mood) sau cấu trúc mang tính cấp bách "It is imperative that + S + (should) bare infinitive" → động từ luôn ở dạng nguyên mẫu không "to" "report".

questions.content: Following the annual executive summit, department heads were instructed to draft strategic roadmaps for their ------- divisions.
options: respective
respectful
respectable
respecting
questions.explanation: Bẫy từ vựng cao cấp: "respective" = tương ứng của từng người/từng bộ phận; "respectful" = thể hiện sự tôn trọng; "respectable" = đáng kính. Cụm "their respective divisions" = các bộ phận tương ứng của họ → Chọn (A).

questions.content: ------- the preliminary audit balance sheets thoroughly, the comptroller identified several unaccounted disbursements.
options: Having evaluated
Evaluated
To evaluate
Being evaluated
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề đồng chủ ngữ ở dạng phân từ hoàn thành (Perfect participle): "Having evaluated..." diễn tả hành động thẩm định đã hoàn tất trước khi phát hiện ra các khoản chi không có chứng từ.

questions.content: ------- persistent supply chain bottlenecks across the Pacific corridor, Apex Electronics fulfilled its overseas obligations on schedule.
options: Notwithstanding
Although
Despite of
Whereas
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ ("persistent supply chain bottlenecks...") mang nghĩa nhượng bộ → chọn giới từ "Notwithstanding" (= Despite / In spite of). "Although/Whereas" cần mệnh đề; "Despite of" sai ngữ pháp.

questions.content: Upgrading our fleet to hybrid commercial vans proved to be an remarkably ------- decision, reducing operational fuel expenditures by thirty percent.
options: economical
economic
economy
economize
questions.explanation: Bẫy tính từ: "economical" = tiết kiệm chi phí; "economic" = thuộc về nền kinh tế vĩ mô. Quyết định giúp tiết kiệm chi phí nhiên liệu → chọn "economical" (A).

questions.content: The chief legal officer demanded that the non-disclosure agreements be kept strictly ------- throughout the duration of the buyout negotiations.
options: confidential
confidentially
confidence
confiding
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "keep + O + adj" (giữ cái gì ở trạng thái như thế nào). Sau phó từ chỉ mức độ "strictly" cần tính từ → chọn "confidential" (bảo mật).

questions.content: Under no circumstances ------- proprietary client datasets to be transferred onto unencrypted portable hard drives.
options: are
is
have
were
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ với cụm từ phủ định "Under no circumstances + are + datasets (danh từ số nhiều) + to be transferred..." (cấu trúc be to V thể hiện mệnh lệnh cấm đoán).

questions.content: ------- the manufacturing consortium has exceeded its initial production quota, the board approved an additional incentive dividend.
options: Given that
In spite of
Regardless
Except that
questions.explanation: Liên từ chỉ lý do/căn cứ: "Given that + clause" = xét thấy rằng / căn cứ vào việc... Phù hợp với mệnh đề chỉ lý do vì liên doanh đã vượt chỉ tiêu sản xuất.

questions.content: The proposed commercial zoning revision has generated ------- debate among municipal developers and neighborhood residents.

considerate
consideration
considerately

questions.content: New environmental regulations mandate that every industrial chemical refinery ------- continuous smokestack monitoring telemetry.
options: install
installs
installed
installing

questions.content: The corporate restructuring was ------- implemented to reduce overhead expenses, although internal sources suggest it aimed to centralize executive decision-making.
options: ostensibly
authentically
reluctantly
subordinately

questions.content: All hazardous industrial waste containers must be labeled and manifested ------- municipal environmental protection statutes.

in spite of
contrary to
on behalf of

comprehensible
comprehend
comprehension

questions.content: Not only ------- the executive team to renegotiate the vendor contract, but they also secured a ten percent volume rebate.
options: did the committee manage
the committee managed
was the committee managing
managing the committee

questions.content: An entry-level data processing clerk ------- transmitted unredacted customer transaction records to an external testing server.

decisively
deliberately
punctually

Apart from
In addition
Instead of

questions.content: The ethics committee insisted that every prospective board member ------- any potential conflicts of interest before taking office.

discloses
disclosed
disclosing

appreciating

contained
contains
containment

questions.content: Only candidates who demonstrate ------- adherence to ethical research protocols will be certified for clinical laboratory trials.

tentative
arbitrary
negligent

unproven
